title: iPhone free for 5 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 5 min (since 16:37Z; released by iphone-runner). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: phone-queue (owner iphone-runner; its note names the phone).
Owners: take it now (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...), or say here why not. Desk (mgmt-desk-2): please make sure the next one starts.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

The iPhone is free on purpose, not stuck.

- Two short Simulator jobs (toolbar-resize, then scroll-cb) run first, about 20 min, so the Mac is quiet for the next phone test.
- Then the phone runs v8's final check (P-114), or the v7 fast-flick checks if P-114 isn't ready.
- I fixed the board note that made the alarm count this as idle.

What you need to do: nothing.
